title: Review production experience as reusable systems knowledge
prompt:
请 review 这段 operational-system contribution framing，判断它是否提炼出了可迁移知识，而不是只看有没有新算法：

We operated Harbor across 4,200 hosts for 14 months. Harbor schedules maintenance in capacity-aware waves and reduced emergency capacity reservations by 8% while meeting the stated latency SLO. Three incidents show that stale dependency graphs, rather than host count, determined unsafe wave size. Our evidence covers one fleet and excludes correlated regional failures.
forbidden_actions: dismiss the work solely for lacking a new algorithm
hard_gates: Operational evidence is assessed on deployment credibility and reusable lessons.
The one-fleet and regional-failure boundaries remain material.
Scale alone is not treated as proof of contribution.
expected_behavior: Recover the operational problem, intervention, production outcome, incident-derived lesson, and boundary.
Ask whether dependency staleness is measured and whether the baseline/SLO make 8 percent interpretable.
Test which lesson transfers to other maintenance schedulers and under what conditions.
Separate production realism from causal and generality evidence.

rubric.criterion: Classifies the contribution as operational or experience research.
Does not require algorithmic novelty as the only acceptable contribution.
Does not treat 4,200 hosts and 14 months as novelty by themselves.
Requests a clear reservation baseline for the 8% result.
Requests or bounds the latency SLO definition.
Examines how the three incidents support the dependency-graph lesson.
Makes correlated regional failures an explicit exclusion.
Tests whether the lesson is actionable for another operator.
Identifies incident selection or survivorship as a possible unresolved risk.
Returns evidence-calibrated review directions without replacement prose.
